reuse.why: The new exclusion goes into the existing isCategoryFilled predicate that every month-wide action consults, with a small isFixedGroup helper; the feeding queries are extended rather than unified.

duplication.why: The same notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes column are added to three separate category queries (getBudgetData, getAverageFillCategories, setZero), extending an already triplicated selection.

placement.why: The rule sits in the month-fill selection block of budget/actions.ts that the tree documents as the place deciding which categories month-wide fills write.

scope.why: Only the selection rule, the queries feeding it, and a release note change.

maintainability.why: The decision is one predicate a maintainer can find easily; the need to keep three SQL queries in sync for its inputs is the remaining fragility.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions still filter through isCategoryFilled, which now applies the #fixed rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated JOIN is written identically in each query, not disguised.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup check inside isCategoryFilled in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and all average/last-month actions; the group-notes JOIN is repeated in three queries that feed it.
